Strategy: Reward the wide [25,50] band with half the item size and penalize the [6,20] sliver band with a quarter of the item size.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item / 2 if 25 <= r - item <= 50 else 0) - (item / 4 if 6 <= r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
